headline: Protocol breach: Rajshahi divisional commissioner removed after viral video
summary: Yusuf Ali was made OSD after a video showed him attempting to embrace the prime minister at Rajshahi airport.
details: Rajshahi Divisional Commissioner Yusuf Ali has been withdrawn and attached to the public administration ministry as an officer on special duty (OSD) following a protocol breach.
The action follows a viral 14-second video from Tuesday evening at Shah Makhdum Airport, where Ali reportedly attempted to hug the prime minister while seeing him off.
In the clip, the prime minister is seen shaking hands with officials before stepping back to stop Ali and advising him to remain in line.
The order, issued Tuesday night, states the withdrawal is in the public interest and takes effect immediately, though it does not explicitly link the transfer to the incident.
Ali handed over his responsibilities to Additional Divisional Commissioner (Revenue) Rezaul Alam Sarkar around 11pm Tuesday before leaving Rajshahi.
The OSD position is typically viewed as a disciplinary measure, as officials in this role have no active part in policymaking or government implementation.
caption:
Attempted to hug the prime minister? Rajshahi's divisional commissioner is now OSD.

Rajshahi Divisional Commissioner Yusuf Ali has been withdrawn and attached to the public administration ministry as an officer on special duty (OSD) following a protocol breach.

The action follows a viral 14-second video from Tuesday evening at Shah Makhdum Airport, where Ali reportedly attempted to hug the prime minister while seeing him off.

In the clip, the prime minister is seen shaking hands with officials before stepping back to stop Ali and advising him to remain in line.

The order, issued Tuesday night, states the withdrawal is in the public interest and takes effect immediately, though it does not explicitly link the transfer to the incident.

Ali handed over his responsibilities to Additional Divisional Commissioner (Revenue) Rezaul Alam Sarkar around 11pm Tuesday before leaving Rajshahi.

The OSD position is typically viewed as a disciplinary measure, as officials in this role have no active part in policymaking or government implementation.

headline: 3 carriages of Karnaphuli Express derail in Cumilla's Laksam
summary: The engine and three carriages of the Dhaka-bound train derailed near Naoti Station, halting services on the up line from Chattogram.
details: The engine and three carriages of the Dhaka-bound Karnaphuli Commuter train derailed in Laksam, Cumilla, on Wednesday around 12:40 pm.
According to Laksam Railway Police chief Rajib Chandra Kar, the accident occurred at the outer signal of Naoti Station.
No casualties have been reported so far in the incident.
The derailment has halted train movement on the up line from Chattogram towards Dhaka, while services on the down line remain normal.
A relief train is required to recover the derailed carriages before services on the up line can be resumed.
caption:
A Dhaka-bound Karnaphuli Commuter train derailed in Cumilla's Laksam today, halting train movement on the up line.

The engine and three carriages of the Dhaka-bound Karnaphuli Commuter train derailed in Laksam, Cumilla, on Wednesday around 12:40 pm.

According to Laksam Railway Police chief Rajib Chandra Kar, the accident occurred at the outer signal of Naoti Station.

No casualties have been reported so far in the incident.

The derailment has halted train movement on the up line from Chattogram towards Dhaka, while services on the down line remain normal.

A relief train is required to recover the derailed carriages before services on the up line can be resumed.
